approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Non-RFC values such as Message-ID: unavailable currently receive local hashes and can falsely link unrelated emails.
The same issue affects invalid In-Reply-To and References values because all whitespace-delimited fallback tokens are accepted.
Reuse the standard-library email parser and tighten only the shared header-token filter; retain valid hash-only thread behavior.
No mailbox access, semantic thread inference, raw identifier persistence or model call is permitted.
632 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment-boundary tests passed offline; malformed bare and angle-bracketed tokens stay standalone while valid and multi-value RFC-style relationships still pass.
title: Reject malformed email thread identifiers
objective: Prevent malformed Message-ID, In-Reply-To and References values from creating exact email-thread relationships while preserving valid RFC-style hash-only links.
